description_en: This operation updates document tags in a data connection in batches
description_zh: 该接口用于批量更新数据连接中的文档标签
name: BatchUpdateFileTag

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. To get this ID, go to the Model Studio <props="china">console home (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/knowledge-base#/home)</props><props="intl">console home (https://bailian.console.alibabacloud.com/#/home)</props> and click the workspace details icon in the upper-left corner
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间 ID。在百炼的<props="china">控制台首页 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/knowledge-base#/home)</props><props="intl">控制台首页 (https://bailian.console.alibabacloud.com/#/home)</props>，单击页面左上角业务空间详情图标获取
parameters.name: workspace_id

fields.help_en: The file ID. To get this ID, go to the <props="china">application data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props><props="intl">application data (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props> page and click the ID icon next to the file name
fields.help_zh: 数据中心的文件 ID，您可以在<props="china">应用数据 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props><props="intl">应用数据 (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props>页面，单击文件名称旁的 ID 图标获取
fields.name: file_id

fields.help_en: A list of up to 100 tags to associate with the file. The total length of all tags cannot exceed 700 characters
fields.help_zh: 文件关联的标签列表。最多传入100个标签，所有标签字符长度总和不能超过700
fields.name: tags

parameters.help_en: A list of files to update
parameters.name: file_infos

parameters.help_en: The update mode. Valid values are APPEND and OVERWRITE
parameters.help_zh: 更新模式，仅支持APPEND（追加）和OVERWRITE（覆盖）
parameters.name: update_mode

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates that the call was successful

Data.description_en: The data returned by the operation

UpdateFileTagResultList.description_en: A list of the tag update results

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned only if Success is false
ErrorCode.description_zh: 返回错误码，仅当Success为false时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned only if Success is false
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 错误描述信息，仅当 Success 为 false 时返回

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the tags for the specific file were updated. Valid values:

true: The tags were updated successfully.

false: The tag update failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功，可能值为：
true：成功。
false：失败

true: The request was accepted.

false: The request failed, for example, due to an invalid parameter
